title: DeepSeek just open-sourced your replacement
caption:
DeepSeek open-sourced an agent that runs your GitHub repo on its own: it reads the issue, works in its own session and answers with a pull request. 21k stars in about a week.

Want the link? Comment LETS GO and I'll DM it to you. 📩

scenes.narration: Coders, be scared. DeepSeek just open-sourced your replacement.
scenes.title: Your replacement is open source.

scenes.narration: It's called dsh-superagent. It listens to your GitHub repo. Someone asks for work, it opens a work item, does the job in its own session, and replies with a pull request.
scenes.title: What it actually does
lines: Listens to GitHub issues and comments

scenes.narration: Request in. Work item. Agent session. Pull request out. And one panel shows only what a human still has to decide.
scenes.title: Request in, PR out

scenes.narration: Even the setup is done by an agent. Tell your coding agent to read SETUP dot MD, it asks one question at a time, then installs everything.
scenes.title: Set up by an agent, for an agent

lines.text: > Read SETUP.md and set up dsh-superagent with me
agent: one question at a time, then the full plan
pnpm check   typecheck ok   tests ok   build ok

scenes.narration: The rule is attention. It acts only when asked, and speaks only when a human has to act. The rest of the time it just works.
scenes.title: Minimum attention, maximum value
lines: Acts only when asked or allowed by a rule
Speaks only when a human must act
Takes little attention, gives a lot

scenes.narration: MIT licensed, research prototype, not a product. Want the link? Comment LETS GO and I'll send it to your DMs. And follow, so you're not the last to know.
scenes.title: Want the link? Comment: LETS GO
scenes.cta: Comment LETS GO, the link lands in your DMs
